ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized primarily at the distal tips and in discrete focal points near the notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters localized at the left and right distal tips; one prominent high-intensity spot on the inner right lobe near the notch; sparse white pixel scattering on the medial left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the inner lobes, ranging from 5-12 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep from the peduncle attachment point to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations at the distal tips; several irregular jagged notches on the trailing edge suggesting previous mechanical wear.
